svg.text: FROM PROMPT, THROUGH THE AGENT CREW, TO THE GAME
Evidence from a live run: a real model wrote the dialogue through the new Dialogue task and the checks it reuses
Add a Dialogue task to storm_crew
writes DialogueBrief: 30 events, limit 22 words, player term
1 x reply was not valid JSON
verdict REVISE: 11 of 13 checks pass, 6 issues
assist mode adds a text hint
RUN TIMELINE (read from run_log.json, one chip per guardrail attempt)
Run 2: offline replay (scripted model, same checks)
WHAT IS REAL AND WHAT IS SCRIPTED
Real: a live model wrote the brief, 56 lines and the review through the same three agents. The checks blocked 2 Dialogue attempt(s) (29 errors) before the third passed.
The reviewer returned REVISE: 2 checks failed (Daniel stays in the basement; No significant outpost detail). The data is flagged needs_revision and was not copied into the game project.
Not scripted, so not identical to the offline draft: the lines differ. It cites 76 lines; the file has 56, so the reviewer's evidence is the model's own and unverified.
